name: Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino
insider_take: This iconic Strip resort houses the largest man-made beach in North America and some of Vegas' most legendary entertainment venues.
whats_special: The 11-acre Mandalay Beach features a wave pool, lazy river, and 2,700 tons of real sand imported from California. The resort is also home to the House of Blues Las Vegas and hosts major headliner residencies at Michelob ULTRA Arena, making it a premier entertainment destination.
pro_tip: Book a Cabana at Mandalay Beach during weekdays for significantly lower rates and a more relaxed atmosphere compared to crowded weekends.
dont_miss: The Shark Reef Aquarium, featuring over 2,000 animals including sharks, rays, and sea turtles in a 1.3-million-gallon walk-through tunnel. It's one of the few places in Vegas where you can experience marine life without leaving the Strip.
pros: 11-acre tropical lagoon with beach and wave pool
Prime Las Vegas Strip location with monorail access
Diverse entertainment including Shark Reef Aquarium
Multiple dining options from casual to celebrity chef restaurants
cons: Large resort with long walking distances between amenities
Premium pricing for attractions and dining
